title: RPZ vs DCVA: identify the hazard requirement before specifying an assembly
description: A comparison framework for reduced-pressure-zone and double-check valve assemblies that keeps hazard classification, utility approval, and installation scope ahead of product shopping.
prompt: What degree of protection and site requirement decide between RPZ and DCVA?
answer: RPZ and DCVA selection starts with the governing protection requirement. They should not be treated as equivalent options because they are both backflow assemblies.
urgency: Do not change assembly type without the responsible authority confirming the protection requirement and approval path.
diagramAlt: Reduced pressure zone assembly used as a reference in device-family comparison
aliases: reduced pressure zone vs double check valve assembly
identifiers: Record the current assembly, system use, model, and size.
Confirm the program requirement and any approved-list criteria.
Include drainage, access, testability, and filing in the comparison.
